item.tib: dam can gnad bskul lha srung bskul ba srog gi spu gri
item.coloph: ces dam can gnad bskul brnag pa kun dril 'di ni bstan dgra 'dul phyir kho bo thos chung lhag bsam dkar ba khi khar gyis lcags byi stag zla'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i nyin du grub par gyur la gshen bstan dbu 'phang mtho zhing bon gshen bstan pa dar zhing rgyas nas sems can la dge legs su gyur cig mang ga lam//

item.tib: zab mo sku gsum bcud dril las khrid kyi gong 'chad mu tig mdzes phreng
